limitations: Single published patient; source support only.

patient_identity.statement: The paper’s single 8-month-old female patient matches Ma and Yu (2018) patient1, sex and P8M disease presentation. Previously normal growth/development, healthy nonconsanguineous parents and no family history are reported.

genotype.statement: The patient has homozygous HMGCS2 c.1502G>A, p.R501Q in exon9, verified by Sanger. The source reports chr1:120293450 without an explicit assembly, whereas the packet provides GRCh38 chr1:119750827.
limitations: Source does not directly establish packet transcript/accession version or GRCh38 conversion.

segregation.statement: Both parents are heterozygous for c.1502G>A; the child is homozygous. Parental Sanger confirmation is explicitly reported and shown.

phase.statement: Homozygous child with each parent heterozygous supports biparental transmission of the same allele; this is not a two-distinct-variant phase ambiguity.

causal_confidence.statement: Homozygous variant, parental segregation, severe hypoglycemic acidosis and repeat urinary 4-hydroxy-6-methyl-2-pyranone elevation support the authors’ HMCSD diagnosis. Initial urine profile suggested glutaric aciduriaII, reconsidered after repeat testing. Bioinformatic predictions are reported, not functional proof.
limitations: No patient enzyme assay or variant-specific functional confirmation; source diagnosis does not independently validate packet PATHOGENIC classification.

phenotype_completeness.statement: The six packet items are a selective subset. Diarrhea, fever, vomiting, hypotonia, hepatic enlargement, elevated ammonia, myocardial injury, coagulation abnormality, respiratory distress and MRI basal-ganglia/atrophy changes are described. Source reports normal prior development and no prior seizures.
limitations: Packet omits clinically relevant features; admission-consciousness qualifier retained; discussion’s general disease manifestations are not all patient findings.

assessment.statement: Homozygous HMGCS2 c.1502G>A / p.Arg501Gln matches. NM_005518.4 and NP_005509.1 accession versions and GRCh38 genomic change are packet normalization beyond the paper’s explicit exon9/chr1:120293450 statement.

Coma is excluded in the packet. Admission exam explicitly describes clear consciousness, while the course describes recurrent seizures and intensive support without explicitly excluding coma throughout.
limitations: Time-specific absence at admission, not a lifetime/course-wide negative.

assessment.statement: A seizure before admission and recurrent inpatient seizures are reported.
Glucose1.46 mmol/L against stated reference3.3–5.3 supports hypoglycemia.
pH6.87, base excess−29.6 and anion gap32 support severe metabolic acidosis.
ALT233 and AST253 U/L exceed the stated reference intervals.
Dicarboxylic acids are elevated on both initial and repeat urinary organic-acid testing.
